description_zh: 跟随的SUV（ego）在Stockton Street直行，前方Waymo AV因红灯减速停车，SUV追尾前车。选择后车为ego以测试其对前车减速的应对能力。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV began slowing to stop within the crosswalk along Market Street, and the front of the trailing SUV made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
WEATHER (MARK 1 to 2 ITEMS) A. CLEAR: VEH 1 (X), VEH 2 (X)
evidence.reason: 后车追尾前车，前车减速，典型的跟车碰撞场景，选择后车为ego（主动移动方）以测试其能否及时制动。
